Here’s a quick snapshot of some of the most talked‑about movies that have hit theaters (or streaming platforms) in the last few months of 2024.  (Release dates are U.S. theatrical releases unless otherwise noted.)

| Title | Release Date | Genre | Director | Notable Cast | Platform |
|-------|--------------|-------|----------|--------------|----------|
| **Oppenheimer** | Jan 19 2024 | Historical drama | Christopher Nolan | Cillian Murphy, Emily Blunt, Matt Damon | Theatrical |
| **The Marvels** | Feb 16 2024 | Super‑hero / Action | Nia DaCosta | Brie Larson, Iman Vellani, Teyonah Parris | Theatrical |
| **Killers of the Flower Moon** | Mar 1 2024 | Crime / Drama | Martin Scorsese | Leonardo DiCaprio, Robert De Niro, Lily Gladstone | Theatrical |
| **Dune: Part Two** | Mar 15 2024 | Sci‑fi / Adventure | Denis Villeneuve | Timothée Chalamet, Zendaya, Rebecca Ferguson | Theatrical |

| **Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3** | May 26 2024 | Super‑hero / Action | James Gunn | Chris Pratt, Zoe Saldana, Dave Bautista | Theatrical |
| **The Color Purple** | Jun 1 2024 | Drama | Steven Spielberg | Jennifer Hudson, Cynthia Erivo | Theatrical |
| **The Last Voyage of the Demeter** | Jun 15 2024 | Horror / Thriller | John Pogue | Daniel Radcliffe, Lily James | Theatrical |
| **The Hunger Games: The Ballad of Songbirds & Snakes** (re‑release) | Jun 20 2024 | Fantasy | Francis Lawrence | Anya Taylor‑Joy, Josh O'Connor | Streaming (Disney+) |
| **The Marvels** (extended cut) | Jun 30 2024 | Super‑hero | Nia DaCosta | Brie Larson, Iman Vellani | Streaming (Disney+) |
| **The Last Voyage of the Demeter** (extended cut) | Jul 5 2024 | Horror | John Pogue | Daniel Radcliffe, Lily James | Streaming (Netflix) |

### Quick Highlights

- **Oppenheimer** – Christopher Nolan’s biopic about J. Robert Oppenheimer has been a critical darling, earning praise for its performances and historical detail.
- **Killers of the Flower Moon** – Martin Scorsese’s crime drama set in 1920s Oklahoma, featuring a powerhouse cast led by DiCaprio and De Niro.
- **Dune: Part Two** – The long‑awaited sequel to Denis Villeneuve’s epic, continuing Paul Atreides’ journey on Arrakis.
- **The Little Mermaid** – Disney’s live‑action remake starring Halle Bailey as Ariel, with a fresh musical score.
- **Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3** – The final chapter of the beloved MCU team, packed with humor and heartfelt moments.

### Where to Watch

- **Theatrical releases**: Check your local cinema listings for showtimes.  
- **Streaming**: Many of the above titles will soon appear on Disney+, Netflix, HBO Max, or Amazon Prime Video, often with extended cuts or bonus content.

If you’re looking for something specific—like a particular genre, director, or actor—just let me know and I can narrow it down further!
